blocks.p: estimate · RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell / DGX Spark = run on our own hardware; its cost is an estimate, explained on hover, focus or tap of the amount: the machine's wall-clock time on the run, first to last answer while it was running (pauses, estimated from gaps of more than 10 minutes between answers, left out and listed), × $2.49/h per NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB) (Runpod's price for the card) or × $0.213/h per NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) (its purchase over three years plus electricity; see Method), each run charged in full even when runs shared the machine, so at most; sorting and the cost chart use the estimate; list = maker's list price × our token counts; unmarked = provider's price × usage the API reported.
SubQ Snap Preview and SubQ Snap 1.1 returned the same answer to every question (and the same probabilities on 3,276 of 3,288); shown once.

Perplexity Decider 27B v1.2 (API) and Perplexity Decider 27B v1.2 (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell): two setups of the same model, one on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB) and one through Perplexity's API; not verified to be identical weights or settings. Its row is the API setup on every test; Perplexity Decider 27B v1.2 (NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell) is under the row's other settings and All setups.

blocks.p: estimate · RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell / DGX Spark = run on our own hardware; its cost is an estimate, explained on hover, focus or tap of the amount: the machine's wall-clock time on the run, first to last answer while it was running (pauses, estimated from gaps of more than 10 minutes between answers, left out and listed), × $2.49/h per NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB) (Runpod's price for the card) or × $0.213/h per NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) (its purchase over three years plus electricity; see Method), each run charged in full even when runs shared the machine, so at most; sorting and the cost chart use the estimate; list = maker's list price × our token counts; unmarked = provider's price × usage the API reported.
